description: This file is a shell script used for setting up, building, patching, and testing a complex C++ software project involving multiple repositories, including Thunder, ThunderTools, entservices-apis, and googletest, as well as configuring coverage analysis and running unit tests. It orchestrates environment setup, dependency installation, repository checkout and patching, building components with CMake, and executing tests with coverage reporting.
